title: TD Social iPhone app: CRM screens fit the app, and Marketing Chat fits a phone
text: TD Social is the planned iPhone app for TD Talk, Portal chats, WhatsApp, the Inbox and Marketing Chat; the app itself is not part of this release. The CRM screens now adjust only when opened inside that app. In a normal browser the one visible change is Marketing Chat on a narrow screen (under 768 px wide): it shows the chat list, then the open chat with a back arrow, one at a time.
points: Inside the app only: no side menu or top bar, bigger tap areas, larger small text, light mode only. Normal browsers are unchanged.
The part that decides what each person sees in the app and keeps the phone list is built but switched off until it is turned on.
